title: graviton 16x pvp pack
body: Graviton 16x is a sleek, dark-themed PvP resource pack crafted to elevate your Minecraft combat experience. Featuring a stunning and clean black-and-grey aesthetic, this pack drastically reduces visual clutter so you can focus entirely on your opponents. Every element has been optimized for high-intensity battles, including short swords to maximize your field of view, low fire to keep your screen clear, and minimalist GUIs for better situational awareness. Built on a smooth 16x resolution, it ensures maximum FPS performance even during intense fights. Whether you are grinding BedWars, SkyWars, or classic duels, Graviton 16x delivers the perfect blend of stealthy style and competitive edge to help you dominate the leaderboard.
